# HackerBuys

> The stuff Hacker News actually recommends. 1938 physical products ranked by the Hacker News commenters who own them, with every opinion linked to its comment.

Opinions and ownership were extracted by AI, so they can be wrong: check the linked comment before relying on one. Counts cover the comments scanned so far, not all of Hacker News.

## Data

- [Sitemap of all product and category pages](https://hn.shellbear.me/sitemap.xml)
- [Full catalogue as JSON](https://hn.shellbear.me/data/index.json): for each product, k is the page at /p/k, n the name, c the category, own the distinct owners, pos, neu and neg the verdicts, and ly the last year mentioned.
- [Source code and methods](https://github.com/shellbear/hackerbuys)
